notes: Deploy only src/CabalGate.sol:CabalGate for the existing Ethereum mainnet hook 0xf41b6ff942a082c0d320a0c151310ac2a922a0c0. CabalHook and CabalCoin are existing dependencies and are not deployed by this manifest. CabalGate creates its own QuestionBuilder and ImpactEstimator. The flat constructor argument order is hook, initialOwner, intake, imd, signer, action, maxBuyAmount, maxSellAmount, maxImpactBps, maxDriftBps, panelSize, quorum, windowHours. $owner receives gate ownership through Ownable2Step; the deployment factory receives no owner role. The constructor builds and validates Config with oracleVerifier equal to the new gate address and boolAnswerType equal to 0. Initial limits are 1000000000000000000000000 IMD minor units per buy and 10000000000000000000000000 CABAL minor units per sell, 300 bps trade impact, 500 bps price drift, panel size 30, quorum 20 and a one-hour window. The constructor requires an initialized hook and obtains poolManager, poolKey and CABAL from it; Intake and IMD must have code, and IMD must match the hook. The gate retains its hook() and cabal() getters. After deployment, the existing hook owner separately calls hook.setGate(gate) once. Binding requires gate.hook() to equal the hook and gate.cabal() to equal the hook's CABAL; replacement is refused. This owner action is not a factory initialization call. Gate ownership alone does not grant hook ownership. The manifest supplies no ETH funding or initialization calls.
